question: For Federal FY2025 compliance evaluation, does the permit cover page itself independently establish any enforceable effluent limitations or monitoring requirements, or are the operative limits and requirements located solely in Parts I–IV of the same permit instrument referenced by the span?
semantic_arguments: Part I, Part II, Part III, and Part IV
notes: The span binds compliance to both the cover page and to limitations, requirements, and other conditions set forth in Parts I–IV, but the isolated span does not establish whether the cover page is itself a source of numeric limits or monitoring duties or only an integrative frame whose operative content resides in Parts I–IV. The phrase 'other conditions' may also bear on whether conditional or no-discharge states are governed at the cover-page level versus within the referenced parts.
